rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something with exuberant high spirits and enthusiasm.

example.traditional: 佢哋興高采烈咁慶祝勝利。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hing3 gou1 coi2 lit6 gam3 hing3 zuk1 sing3 lei6

rows.note: Use this when the exuberance is mainly shown through physical energy or liveliness.

example.english: The children ran around the park exuberantly.
example.traditional: 班細路好有活力咁喺公園跑嚟跑去。
example.jyutping: baan1 sai3 lou6 hou2 jau5 wut6 lik6 gam3 hai2 gung1 jyun2 paau2 lai4 paau2 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when the exuberance is visibly expressed through animated gestures or body movement.

example.english: They jumped up and down exuberantly after hearing they had won.
example.traditional: 佢聽到中獎之後，手舞足蹈咁跳咗起身。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teng1 dou3 zung3 zoeng2 zi1 hau6 sau2 mou5 zuk1 dou6 gam3 tiu3 zo2 hei2 san1
